note: The bands Extreme Flight's 105.5 in Slick 580 plant has to land in, from docs/SLICK-STAGE1.md, which derives each from EF's data sheet and drawing, Desert Aircraft's DA-120, Falcon's measured static table for the DA-120 on its 28 x 10 and APC's data for the prop's shape (npm run slick:derive prints them; --check holds these derived figures to it). The widths are the Extra's (tests/extra-thresholds.json), each for the same reason. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

s1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent of the throttle stick (0.94 of the full rpm on the DA-120's dyno curve, throttle_rpm), derived 39.94 from Falcon's thrust, APC's zero thrust advance ratio and the component drag build up; 12 percent either way, the Extra's, for the thrust line's slope and cd0

s2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax) at the wing's CLmax at the stall's own Reynolds number, 4.4e5 on the mean chord: 0.902, 0.9 of Sheldahl and Klimas' NACA 0012 (SAND80-2114 Table 2: 0.9811 at 3.6e5, 1.0749 at 7e5), derived 13.88; alphaStall CLmax over the wing's own slope; the Extra's band in proportion, 0.94 to 1.14 of the formula, since the plant reads the stall at the blend's midpoint

s3_glide.source: L/D at 1.4 Vs, 19.4 m/s, derived 14.06, 12 percent either way, the Extra's

s4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 42.53, 10 percent either way

s5_roll.source: pb/2V at full aileron on the sheet's high rate (38 up, 37 down), Clda throw_a / -Clp, derived 0.3696 (348 deg/s at 22 m/s); 25 percent either way, the width the large deflection correction K' carries. EF's 'blistering roll rate'

s6_hover.source: hanging on the prop, the nose held up by the elevator and rudder in the slipstream, the height by the throttle: the rpm share where the thrust meets the weight, sqrt(W / T_static) 0.6343, as a stick on the DA-120's dyno curve (throttle_rpm), derived 0.3930; 5 percent either way

s7_vertical.source: straight up at full throttle, the climb speed where the thrust meets the weight and the zero lift drag, derived 26.31; 10 percent either way

s8_torque_roll.source: hanging at the hover with the ailerons let go: the prop's torque_arm W less the swirl's roll (SWIRL_KEEP 0.74, Selig 2010, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md) and less the roll of the fin holding the right thrust's yaw (thrust_yaw 3 deg, prop_x T sin 3 deg over l_v at the fin's height z_v), against the air the turning wing sweeps through (rot_k), steady at sqrt(Q / k), derived 136 deg/s, to the left; 25 percent either way

s9_aileron_hover.source: the same with full right aileron: the ailerons' inboard share in the slipstream beats the net torque, derived 139 deg/s right; 40 percent either way, the difference of two estimates

s10_zero_speed.source: hanging still, full up elevator and full right rudder from rest: the slipstream's dp on the surfaces' immersed shares, each saturating on a flat plate (hi_alpha), derived 12.06 in pitch and 8.00 in yaw; 25 percent either way. A petrol engine idles rather than stopping: at its idle the wash's dp, and the authority, is (idle / hover rpm)^2 = 0.0978 of the hover's, under 1.5 times that

s11_harrier.source: level at a body angle of attack of 40 deg, the throttle holding height: the stalled wing's plate lift and the thrust's vertical share against the weight, derived 11.34 m/s at a stick of 0.346 with the elevator at 74 percent of its throw; the speed 20 percent and the throttle 15 percent either way, the elevator short of full

s12_knife_edge.source: rolled right to 90 deg at 30 m/s, height held on the rudder, the right thrust 3 deg down from the axis and its yaw on the rudder too: derived 25.5 deg of sideslip at a stick of 0.565 with the rudder at 85 percent of its throw; the sideslip 25 percent and the throttle 15 percent either way, the rudder short of full

s13_rest.source: the sheet's side view on its wheels, 9.38 deg nose up, the CG 0.4082 m up, 10.9 percent of the weight on the tailwheel; half a degree, 5 mm and 3.5 points either way

s14_takeoff.source: full throttle from standing, the tail up at 8 m/s and the nose to 8 deg at 15 m/s: liftoff at 15.8 m/s after 8.61 m (slick:derive); 40 percent short and 60 long, the Extra's, since the plant's roll has the gear's springs, the engine's spool and the pilot's hands in it and the derivation has none

s16_cross_host.source: the Slick's recorded take off, hover, torque roll and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
